# MDL001 · `unused-suppression`

<!-- Generated by tools/gendocs from internal/rules: do not edit. -->

A suppression comment suppresses nothing.

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | suppressions |
| Default severity | info |
| Fix | safe |
| Flags | unsuppressible |

## Why

A `# mydumper-lint: disable-…` comment that no longer matches a diagnostic hides nothing today, and will silently hide a real problem tomorrow. The fix removes the unused rules from the comment, or the whole comment.

## Example

With mydumper v0.19.3-3:

❌ Before:

```ini
[mydumper]
# see [docs]
# mydumper-lint: disable-next-line=MDL402

routines=1
```

```text
3:36-3:42 info MDL001[unused-suppression] unused suppression: MDL402 reported nothing here
  fix (safe): Remove the suppression comment
```

✅ After `mydumper-lint check --fix`:

```ini
[mydumper]
# see [docs]
#

routines=1
```

## Configuration

Enabled by default. To change its severity or turn it off:

```yaml
rules:
  severity:
    MDL001: warning   # or error, info, off
```

Its diagnostics mean mydumper ignores the whole file: they cannot be suppressed by comments, only by the configuration or `--ignore`.
